_comment: The Elder's Gauntlet: the game's endgame, challengeable once Content.gauntlet_requirement quests are finished (see data/quests.json). Trials are attempted strictly in order -- Journal.gauntlet_stage is an index into 'trials' below, exactly as a quest tracks a position in its own 'steps'. Two kinds exist: 'tamer' (a formal battle against a person's team, same rules as an ordinary tamer battle -- see docs/DESIGN.md section 35 -- fought via BattleState.create_tamer) and 'attune' (a formal encounter with one wild creature that only counts as passed if it is Attuned, not merely defeated -- fought via BattleState.create() with no_flee set). Both kinds refuse running. See docs/DESIGN.md section 39.

trials.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Elder One
intro: [PLACEHOLDER] The first elder looks up from whatever they were doing and does not seem surprised to see you.
victory: [PLACEHOLDER] The first elder inclines their head, once.
defeat: [PLACEHOLDER] Come back when you are ready, the first elder says, not unkindly.
passed_text: [PLACEHOLDER] The first elder has nothing more to prove between you.
waiting_text: [PLACEHOLDER] The first elder shakes their head. Not out of order.

trials.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Elder Two
intro: [PLACEHOLDER] The second elder does not fight you directly. Something else stands between you, and it is not looking for a fight either.
victory: [PLACEHOLDER] It settles. The second elder nods, as if that was always going to be the answer.
spared: [PLACEHOLDER] It goes down, and the second elder's face does not change. That is not what was asked of you.
defeat: [PLACEHOLDER] The second elder says nothing. You will need to come back to this.
passed_text: [PLACEHOLDER] The second elder already knows what you proved here.
waiting_text: [PLACEHOLDER] The second elder will not be rushed, and will not go first.
trials.no_flee_message: [PLACEHOLDER] There is no leaving this one unfinished.

trials.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Elder Three
intro: [PLACEHOLDER] The third elder is already standing, and has been waiting for you specifically, and not for very long.
victory: [PLACEHOLDER] The third elder says the thing the other two were waiting for someone to say first.
defeat: [PLACEHOLDER] Not yet, the third elder says. Not far off, either.
passed_text: [PLACEHOLDER] The third elder has already said what there was to say.
waiting_text: [PLACEHOLDER] The third elder points, without a word, at the one you have not yet faced.

victory_text: [PLACEHOLDER] All three elders, together, say the thing the whole gauntlet was built to ask.
[PLACEHOLDER] This is the ending placeholder. The real one is not written yet.
